method: FAO-56 single crop coefficient, ETc = Kc × ET0

rice.source_name: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 6, Table 12 and paddy rice initial-stage note
rice.standard_conditions: Typical values for non-stressed, well-managed crops in a sub-humid climate; FAO-56 advises climate and wetting adjustments.

nursery.note: FAO-56's 1.05 initial coefficient is specifically for paddy rice with 0.10–0.20 m standing water, sub-humid conditions, and calm to moderate wind. It is a reference estimate for this nursery/seedling stage; a dry or mat nursery can differ and should be checked locally.

transplanting.note: FAO-56 paddy-rice initial value; actual Kc depends on standing water, wetting frequency, and climate.

tillering.note: FAO-56 crop-development coefficient interpolates from Kc_ini to Kc_mid; stage duration is unavailable, so this range is shown.

panicle.note: FAO-56 typical mid-season value; local climate and crop height can change it.

flowering.note: FAO-56 typical mid-season value; local climate and crop height can change it.

grain_fill.note: FAO-56 lists a late-season range of 0.90–0.60; shown as a range because maturity and water management affect the end value.

maturity.note: FAO-56 lists a late-season range of 0.90–0.60; shown as a range because maturity and water management affect the end value.
